before.description: Original, shown left or top. Pass an image with its own alt text.

position.description: Controlled divider position in percent from the left or top.

onPositionChange.description: Called when the divider settles on a new position.

orientation.description: Vertical stacks images top and bottom; changing it swings the divider.

labels.description: Captions over each side. False hides them.

aspectRatio.description: Frame proportions as a CSS aspect-ratio.
